rows.citation: Jaumann C, Wiedholz A, Friedrich A. LGAR: Zero-Shot LLM-Guided Neural Ranking for Abstract Screening in Systematic Literature Reviews. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025.
rows.dataset_version_note: SYNERGY, 26 systematic reviews, 169288 papers, average inclusion rate 4.31 percent; Smid_2020 is one of the 26 but the paper prints no per-review value.
rows.setting: zero-shot relevance scale 0-19 with monoT5 title-only re-ranker
rows.metric: TNR@95% (true negative rate at 95% recall), percent
rows.caveat: Ranking metric over the whole 26-review benchmark (macro-average over reviews, Llama3.3-70B with relevance scale 0-19 and a monoT5 re-ranker), not a per-record include/exclude decision, so it is not comparable to the screener's operating point.
